title: Google signs its biggest rice-methane carbon credit deal with Indian startup Mitti Labs | TechCrunch
summary: Mitti Labs began talks with Google about a year ago, Laguarta told TechCrunch, as the tech company explored adding methane-reduction projects to its carbon-credit portfolio. Laguarta told TechCrunch that the Google agreement is Mitti Labs’ largest offtake deal to date.
